content.title: About
content.content: Chocolate frozen pancakes are a ready‑to‑cook product consisting of thin pancakes flavored with cocoa powder and sugar. They are convenient to store in the freezer and can be quickly prepared on a skillet or in a microwave.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pancakes can be made with whole‑grain flour, increasing their nutritional value.
The chocolate flavor comes from natural cocoa rather than artificial flavorings.
Frozen pancakes retain their texture and aroma for up to 12 months when stored properly.
Traditionally pancakes are served with butter and honey, but chocolate versions pair well with berry sauces.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Pancakes provide a quick source of energy thanks to the carbohydrates they contain.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Cocoa powder is a good source of non‑heme iron, which supports blood formation.

items.title: Antioxidant content
items.content: Cocoa is rich in flavonoids that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Pancakes are usually made with wheat flour, which can be problematic for people with celiac disease.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Sweet pancakes may raise blood glucose levels, so they should be consumed in moderation.

items.title: Thawing temperature
items.content: Improper thawing can cause ice crystals to form, affecting texture.

content.title: How to Cook
content.content: Thaw the pancakes at room temperature for 5‑10 minutes, then cook on a dry skillet 1‑2 minutes per side until golden. Optionally add butter, syrup, or fresh berries.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen pancakes in their original packaging in the freezer at –18 °C. After opening, seal the bag tightly to prevent moisture and odor absorption.
